claims: Initiate or continue broad-spectrum empiric antibiotic therapy for suspected severe infection/sepsis, given leukocytosis (WBC 28.5-36.8 K/uL) and bandemia.

Obtain repeat lactate measurement to assess clearance and resuscitation response, given elevated lactate 3.1-4.4 mmol/L.
Obtain serial troponin and CK-MB measurements and continuous ECG monitoring for evolving myocardial injury (troponin T rising to 3.75 ng/mL, CK-MB 170 ng/mL).

Continue insulin therapy with hourly glucose monitoring for hyperglycemia (fingerstick glucose 292-371 mg/dL).

Maintain supplemental oxygen and monitor SpO2, given desaturation to 84% and current O2 flow 3 L/min.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis and monitor for bleeding, given immobility (bedrest) and anticoagulation.
